value one's privacy: Many teenagers value their privacy, so they feel upset when their parents read their messages without asking.
許多青少年重視自己的隱私，所以父母沒問就看他們的訊息時，他們會很不高興。
value friendship: People who truly value friendship will make time for their friends even when they are very busy.
真正珍惜友誼的人即使非常忙碌，也會抽出時間陪朋友。
value a house at: The expert came to value a house at about ten million dollars because it is close to the MRT station.
專家來估價，把一間房子估價為大約一千萬元，因為它離捷運站很近。
be valued at: This old painting was found in my grandfather's attic, and it is valued at over two million dollars.
這幅舊畫是在我祖父的閣樓裡發現的，它被估價為超過兩百萬元。
value time: Successful students value time and plan each day carefully instead of wasting hours on their phones.
成功的學生珍惜時間，仔細規劃每一天，而不是在手機上浪費好幾個小時。
value quality over quantity: When it comes to clothes, I value quality over quantity and would rather buy one good jacket than five cheap ones.
說到衣服，我重質不重量，寧可買一件好外套也不要買五件便宜的。
vanish into thin air: I put my keys on the table a minute ago, but now they seem to have vanished into thin air.
我一分鐘前把鑰匙放在桌上，但現在它們似乎消失得無影無蹤了。
vanish without a trace: The small plane vanished without a trace over the sea, and no one ever found any part of it.
那架小飛機在海上消失無蹤，從來沒有人找到它的任何部分。
hopes vanished: Our hopes vanished when the other team scored two goals in the last five minutes of the game.
當對方隊伍在比賽最後五分鐘踢進兩球時，我們的希望破滅了。
the species vanished: After its forest home was cut down for farms, the species vanished from the island within twenty years.
在牠們棲息的森林被砍伐改成農地後，那個物種在二十年內就從島上絕跡了。
vanish from sight: We waved goodbye at the station until the train turned the corner and vanished from sight.
我們在車站揮手道別，直到火車轉過彎、從視線消失。
vary from person to person: How much sleep we need can vary from person to person, so some people feel fine after only six hours.
我們需要多少睡眠因人而異，所以有些人只睡六小時就覺得很好。
prices vary: Prices vary a lot between night markets, so it is smart to compare a few stalls before you buy.
各個夜市的價格不一，所以購買前先比較幾個攤位是聰明的做法。
vary one's routine: If you vary your routine by jogging one day and swimming the next, exercise will feel less boring.
如果你改變日常，一天慢跑、隔天游泳，運動就會感覺比較不無聊。
vary in size: The rooms in this hotel vary in size, so a family of four should ask for one of the larger ones.
這間飯店的房間大小不一，所以四口之家應該要求比較大的房間。
vary according to: The price of the summer camp will vary according to how many weeks your child decides to join.
夏令營的價格會隨你孩子決定參加幾週而異。
vary widely: Opinions on the new school uniform vary widely; some students love it, while others think it looks terrible.
大家對新校服的看法差異很大；有些學生很喜歡，有些則覺得很難看。
venture an opinion: After the angry manager finished speaking, nobody in the meeting room dared to venture an opinion.
在生氣的經理講完話之後，會議室裡沒有人敢斗膽提出意見。
venture into business: After teaching for twenty years, my uncle decided to venture into business and opened a small coffee shop.
教書二十年後，我叔叔決定涉足商業，開了一間小咖啡店。
venture a guess: I don't know the answer for sure, but if I had to venture a guess, I would say the bridge is about a hundred years old.
我不確定答案，但如果要我大膽猜測，我會說這座橋大約有一百年歷史。
venture outside: During the strong typhoon last night, nobody in our neighborhood dared to venture outside.
昨晚強烈颱風來襲時，我們社區沒有人敢冒險外出。
nothing ventured, nothing gained: I was nervous about entering the speech contest, but my teacher said, "Nothing ventured, nothing gained."
我對參加演講比賽很緊張，但老師說：「不入虎穴，焉得虎子。」
a joint venture: The two companies started a joint venture to build electric cars, sharing both the costs and the profits.
這兩家公司成立了一家合資企業來製造電動車，共同分擔成本、分享利潤。
view the situation: Before you make a decision, try to view the situation calmly from your parents' point of view as well.
在你做決定之前，試著冷靜地也從你父母的角度來看待情勢。
view with suspicion: Many older people still view with suspicion any message that asks them to click a link for a prize.
許多長輩仍以懷疑眼光看待任何要他們點連結領獎的訊息。
view a house: We went to view a house near my new school, but the rooms were too small for our family.
我們去看了一間在我新學校附近的房子，但房間對我們家來說太小了。
view the matter differently: My brother thinks the movie was boring, but I view the matter differently because I loved the story.
我哥哥覺得那部電影很無聊，但我對此事看法不同，因為我很喜歡那個故事。
be viewed as: In our class, asking the teacher questions is viewed as a sign of curiosity, so everyone speaks up freely.
在我們班上，向老師發問被視為好奇心的表現，所以大家都自在地發言。
in view of: In view of the heavy rain, the school decided to cancel the sports day and hold it next week instead.
鑑於大雨，學校決定取消運動會，改到下週舉行。
